extraSections.heading: Format

exports.name: Bundle
signatures:
interface Bundle {
  readonly files: Record<string, MemoryFile>
  readonly version: number
  addons: string[]
  assets: string[]
  id: string | null
  imports: RecursiveStringObject
  main: string | null
  resolutions: RecursiveStringObject
  empty(): boolean
  keys(): string[]
  exists(key: string): boolean
  mode(key: string): number
  read(key: string): Buffer
  write(key: string, data: string, opts?: BundleWriteOptions): this
  mount(root: string | URL, opts?: BundleMountOptions): Bundle
  unmount(root: string | URL, opts?: BundleMountOptions): Bundle
  toBuffer(opts?: BundleToBufferOptions): Buffer
}
exports.description: An in-memory application bundle: a set of files plus metadata (imports, resolutions, addons, assets) that can be serialized to and parsed from a single buffer.

members.name: Bundle
members.description: Create an empty `Bundle`, optionally supplying a custom `File` class to back stored files.

members.name: addons
members.description: The keys of files in the bundle that are native addons.

members.name: assets
members.description: The keys of files in the bundle that are non-JavaScript assets.

members.name: Bundle.from
members.description: Coerce `value` — a serialized bundle string, a `Buffer`, or an existing `Bundle` — into a `Bundle`.

params.name: value
params.description: The serialized bundle string or buffer to parse, or an existing `Bundle`.

returns.description: The parsed `Bundle`, or `value` itself if it is already a `Bundle`.

throws.condition: the serialized header is not valid JSON.

members.name: Bundle.isBundle
members.description: Check whether `value` is a `Bundle`.

returns.description: `true` if `value` is a `Bundle` instance or exposes the bundle kind symbol, `false` otherwise.

members.name: empty
members.description: Check whether the bundle contains no files.

returns.description: `true` if the bundle contains no files, `false` otherwise.

members.name: exists
members.description: Check whether a file exists at `key`.

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the file to look up.

returns.description: `true` if a file exists at `key`, `false` otherwise.

members.name: files
members.description: The bundle's files, keyed by path, as `MemoryFile` instances.

members.name: id
members.description: An optional identifier for the bundle, or `null` if unset.

members.name: imports
members.description: The bundle's import map, mapping specifiers to file keys.

members.name: keys
members.description: Return the keys of all files in the bundle.

members.name: main
members.description: The key of the bundle's entry file, or `null` if unset.

members.name: mode
members.description: Return the file mode (permission bits) of the file at `key`, or `0` if it doesn't exist.

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the file to look up.

members.name: mount
signatures: mount(root: string | URL, opts?: BundleMountOptions): Bundle
members.description: Return a copy of the bundle with all file keys and import/resolution specifiers rewritten as absolute URLs resolved against `root`.

params.name: root
params.description: The base URL (or URL string) to resolve keys and specifiers against.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options; `conditions` maps import-map condition names to per-condition roots.

returns.description: A new `Bundle` with rewritten keys; the original bundle is left unchanged.

members.name: read
members.description: Return the contents of the file at `key` as a `Buffer`, or `null` if it doesn't exist.

params.name: key
params.description: The key of the file to read.

members.name: resolutions
members.description: The bundle's per-file import resolutions map, used to override the default import map for specific files.

members.name: toBuffer
members.description: Serialize the bundle to a single `Buffer` containing its header and file contents.

members.name: unmount
signatures: unmount(root: string | URL, opts?: BundleMountOptions): Bundle
members.description: Return a copy of the bundle with all file keys and import/resolution specifiers rewritten as paths relative to `root`, reversing `mount()`.

params.name: root
params.description: The base URL (or URL string) to make keys and specifiers relative to.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options; `conditions` maps import-map condition names to per-condition roots.

returns.description: A new `Bundle` with rewritten keys; the original bundle is left unchanged.

members.name: version
members.description: The bundle format version this implementation produces and expects.

members.name: write
signatures: write(key: string, data: string, opts?: BundleWriteOptions): this
members.description: Add or replace the file at `key` with `data`, optionally marking it as the main entry, an addon, an asset, or aliased in the import map.

params.name: key
params.description: The key (path) to store the file under.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options; `main`, `addon`, `asset`, and `executable` default to `false`, and `alias` and `imports` to unset.

returns.description: The bundle itself, for chaining writes.

exports.name: MemoryFile

members.name: MemoryFile
signatures: new MemoryFile(data: string | Buffer, opts?: MemoryFileOptions)
members.description: Create a `MemoryFile` from `data`, optionally marking it executable or setting an explicit `mode`.

params.name: data
params.description: The file contents; a string is converted to a `Buffer`.

params.name: opts
params.description: Options; `mode` defaults to `0o755` when `executable` is `true`, otherwise `0o644`.

members.name: mode
members.description: Return the file's mode (permission bits).

members.name: read
members.description: Return the file's contents as a `Buffer`.

members.name: size
members.description: Return the file's byte length.

exports.name: MemoryFileOptions

members.name: executable
members.description: Whether the file should default to an executable mode (`0o755` instead of `0o644`).

members.name: mode
members.description: An explicit file mode (permission bits), overriding `executable`.

members.name: File
members.description: A custom file class to use instead of `MemoryFile` for files added to the bundle.

exports.name: BundleWriteOptions
signatures:
interface BundleWriteOptions {
  addon?: boolean
  alias?: string
  asset?: boolean
  executable?: boolean
  imports?: RecursiveStringObject
  main?: boolean
  mode?: number
}

members.name: addon
members.description: Mark the written file as a native addon, adding its key to `addons`.

members.name: alias
members.description: Register the written file's key under this specifier in the bundle's import map.

members.name: asset
members.description: Mark the written file as a non-JavaScript asset, adding its key to `assets`.

members.name: executable
members.description: Whether the written file should default to an executable mode.

members.name: imports
members.description: Per-file import resolutions to record for the written file's key.

members.name: main
members.description: Mark the written file as the bundle's entry point.

members.name: mode
members.description: An explicit file mode (permission bits) for the written file.

exports.name: BundleMountOptions

members.name: conditions
members.description: Per-condition root URLs used to resolve conditional import map entries during `mount()`/`unmount()`.

exports.name: BundleToBufferOptions

members.name: indent
members.description: Number of spaces to indent the JSON header when serializing with `toBuffer()`.

members.name: shared
members.description: Back the serialized buffer with a `SharedArrayBuffer` instead of a regular `ArrayBuffer`.
